Otherwise choose its smallest passing charge/kinetic stratum and define a compact gauge-invariant clock variable tau from the primitive relative-character lattice. Prove invariance under the compact gauge orbit, independence from Smith-basis presentation, nontrivial clock evolution, retarded rather than advanced response and agreement of two independently normalized frequency/redshift calculations on a declared fixture. State separately what is inherited from the matter-clock subsystem and what requires the full gravity-observer BV complex. Export the observable and response into the observer atlas with mutations of charge basis, clock orientation and support rejected.
